summary: End-to-end retest focused on Groq provider support and full pipeline. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases PASS (14 existing test_lumen_e2e.py + 13 new test_groq_and_e2e_extra.py). Validated: /api/health + /api/v1/health both 200, /api/v1/models exposes groq with all 5 expected models (llama-3.3-70b-versatile, llama-3.1-8b-instant, llama3-70b-8192, mixtral-8x7b-32768, gemma2-9b-it), /api/v1/settings/providers includes groq_key_masked + groq_key_configured=false, /api/v1/metrics/llm key_source='emergent', POST /api/v1/settings accepts {provider:'groq', model:'llama-3.3-70b-versatile'} (whitelist OK), POST /api/v1/chat with provider=groq without GROQ_API_KEY returns clear 500 mentioning GROQ_API_KEY (expected graceful error), seed-demo → task poll → dataset preview, process-data + /eda/{id}, generate-insights task → /insights/{id} returns >=1 insight (LLM-backed), /chart/generate returns {chart_type, data}, POST+GET /dashboard/{id} returns charts/kpis arrays, POST /query/{id} with NL question completes, /analytics kpis + profile both 200, /chat real reply + /chat-stream SSE [DONE], and WS /api/v1/ws/pipeline emits stage frames + final complete frame with reply. Frontend: All 5 pages (Insights, /data, Query, Dashboards, Reports, Settings) render with zero page errors (only React Router v7 future-flag warnings, harmless). Settings page: clicking groq provider button populates model dropdown with all 5 groq models, Save POSTs /api/v1/settings → 200 and shows success toast.

minor.issue: Listing still returns duplicate entries for repeated seed-demo calls (carried over from iteration 1).

Response contains 'redis: connected' even though the problem statement explicitly says no Redis is used (CacheService is in-memory). Misleading field — consider removing or renaming to reflect actual cache backend.

issues: Success toast at bottom-right overlaps/obscures the 'Save changes' button on 1920px viewport (confirmed again in this iteration).

action_items: (Optional) /api/v1/health should not report 'redis: connected' when Redis is not in use — the CacheService is in-memory per problem statement.
(Optional, carried over from iter 1) Dedup /api/v1/datasets listing so repeated seed-demo doesn't grow the registry.
(Cosmetic) Move 'Settings saved' toast origin away from the Save button on the Settings page so it doesn't overlap on desktop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Groq integration is correctly wired: ALL_MODELS exposes 5 groq ids; settings whitelist accepts groq; /chat bypasses Emergent for provider=groq and raises a descriptive error when GROQ_API_KEY is empty. Behaviour matches spec.
/api/v1/metrics/llm returns key_source='emergent' correctly when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set; switching to groq (if key present) would swap to 'groq' via existing branch.
endpoints.py at 891 lines should be split by resource (carried over).
Frontend Settings.tsx groq badge label + key_source type extension both present and functional end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all pages render, groq provider switch + save works)

seed_data_creation: Seed dataset (Postgres sales_performance, 260 rows × 8 cols) created via POST /api/v1/datasets/seed-demo during tests. Multiple duplicates exist from repeated seeding across iterations.
